MAYUR ASHOK KALE Workfront Analyst

mayur.kale2293@gmail.com

9029876752

Kalyan, Maharashtra

linkedin.com/in/mayurashokkale

Core Skills

Adobe Workfront Administration •Workflow Design & Automation •Project, Task & Template Configuration •Custom Forms & Approval Workflows •Reports & Dashboards Development •Resource Planning & Workload Management •Request Queues & Intake Management •Adobe Workfront Fusion (Scenario Design & Automation) •Event-Based Automation (Watch Events) •Fusion Modules: Create, Get, Search, Update, Delete •Routers, Filters, Iterator & Aggregator •Data Mapping, Validation & Transformation •REST API Concepts & API Explorer •Automation Troubleshooting & Error Handling •System Audits & Data Optimization •Requirements Analysis & Stakeholder Coordination •Process Mapping & Documentation •User Support, Training & Troubleshooting •Cross-Functional Collaboration •Problem-Solving & Operational Execution •Salesforce Administration, Reports & Dashboards

Profile

Adobe Workfront Analyst / Developer with 4+ years of experience configuring, administering, and optimizing Workfront for project and content execution, workflow automation, reporting, and governance. Strong expertise in templates, approval workflows, custom forms, Reports, dashboards, and system administration, with hands-on experience using Adobe Workfront Fusion for automation and API-based integrations. Skilled in requirements analysis, troubleshooting and error handling, data validation, reporting, and process improvement across cross-functional teams.

Work Experience

Workfront Analyst (Service Delivery Analyst), ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD. 02/2022 – Present | Mumbai

Led end-to-end configuration and administration of Adobe Workfront environments, including project structures, workflows, approval paths, layouts, job roles, schedules, and governance settings. •Partnered with business stakeholders to gather and translate service delivery requirements into scalable Workfront solutions aligned with PMO and operational standards. •Designed and implemented Adobe Workfront instances from scratch, including layout templates, project and request templates, custom forms, request queues, teams, groups, boards, calendars, and proofing workflows. •Acted as the primary Workfront System Administrator, managing project preferences, access levels, users, roles, resource management rules, portfolios, programs, and intake processes in a high-volume FMCG environment. •Built and maintained 150+ advanced reports and 50+ dashboards, providing leadership with visibility into project health, workload distribution, SLA adherence, and resource utilization. •Extended native Workfront workflows using Adobe Workfront Fusion to implement event-driven automation, workflow orchestration, and conditional process logic across Workfront processes. •Developed and supported Fusion scenarios to automate business processes by responding to real-time events and coordinating actions across tasks, approvals, and intake workflows, using Watch Events, filters, routers, and core Workfront actions (Create, Get, Search, Update, Delete). •Performed API-based interactions within Adobe Workfront Fusion using REST APIs, working with endpoints, request/ response data, and supported operations, along with iterators, aggregators, and data validation logic to handle multi- record processing, prevent duplicates, and ensure reliable scenario execution.

Certificates

Adobe Workfront Core Developer – Professional (Certification in Progress)

Adobe Workfront Fusion Developer – Professional (Planned)

Education

Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) Marketing, Mulund College of Commerce 2012 – 2016

Performed troubleshooting and error handling across Workfront and Fusion by reviewing the Fusion Execution Inspector, validating data, conducting QA checks, and resolving configuration or automation issues. •Successfully supported 100+ projects with durations ranging from 3 months to 1 year, assisting project managers with scheduling, task mapping, and resource allocation while ensuring governance compliance. •Created and maintained SOPs, configuration guides, governance documentation, and handover materials, and collaborated with cross-functional teams to support Workfront releases and continuous improvements.

Salesforce Administrator / Analyst (Project-Based), Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai 02/2021 – 01/2022

Supported Salesforce administration and configuration, including users, roles, profiles, permissions, and access controls for internal and client-facing teams. •Designed and maintained Salesforce reports and dashboards to track service delivery KPIs such as case status, turnaround time, workload, and productivity. •Ensured data accuracy and reliable reporting through validation, clean-up, documentation, and user support.

Accounts Receivable Associate, GEBBS HEALTHCARE SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD. 05/2019 – 03/2020 | Mumbai

Processed insurance claims with accuracy and complied with documentation standards. •Prepared appeal packages and maintained high-quality reporting accuracy.

Operations Consultant (Onboarding & KYC), UBER RIDES/EATS - RANDSTAD/KELLY PVT. LTD. 09/2016 – 04/2019 | Mumbai

Managed partner onboarding workflows, ensuring accurate documentation and verification. •Streamlined verification steps to improve onboarding efficiency and reduce turnaround time.

Awards

Star of Business (FY23 & FY25), Accenture Solutions Pvt Ltd

Certificates of Appreciation for outstanding performance in Q1 & Q2 FY25, Accenture Solutions Pvt Ltd

sections.text:
Profile
Adobe Workfront Analyst / Developer with 4+ years of experience configuring, administering, and optimizing Workfront for project and content execution, workflow automation, reporting, and governance. Strong expertise in templates, approval workflows, custom forms, Reports, dashboards, and system administration, with hands-on experience using Adobe Workfront Fusion for automation and API-based integrations. Skilled in requirements analysis, troubleshooting and error handling, data validation, reporting, and process improvement across cross-functional teams.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Work Experience
Workfront Analyst (Service Delivery Analyst), ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD. 02/2022 – Present | Mumbai
Led end-to-end configuration and administration of Adobe Workfront environments, including project structures, workflows, approval paths, layouts, job roles, schedules, and governance settings. •Partnered with business stakeholders to gather and translate service delivery requirements into scalable Workfront solutions aligned with PMO and operational standards. •Designed and implemented Adobe Workfront instances from scratch, including layout templates, project and request templates, custom forms, request queues, teams, groups, boards, calendars, and proofing workflows. •Acted as the primary Workfront System Administrator, managing project preferences, access levels, users, roles, resource management rules, portfolios, programs, and intake processes in a high-volume FMCG environment. •Built and maintained 150+ advanced reports and 50+ dashboards, providing leadership with visibility into project health, workload distribution, SLA adherence, and resource utilization. •Extended native Workfront workflows using Adobe Workfront Fusion to implement event-driven automation, workflow orchestration, and conditional process logic across Workfront processes. •Developed and supported Fusion scenarios to automate business processes by responding to real-time events and coordinating actions across tasks, approvals, and intake workflows, using Watch Events, filters, routers, and core Workfront actions (Create, Get, Search, Update, Delete). •Performed API-based interactions within Adobe Workfront Fusion using REST APIs, working with endpoints, request/ response data, and supported operations, along with iterators, aggregators, and data validation logic to handle multi- record processing, prevent duplicates, and ensure reliable scenario execution.
Performed troubleshooting and error handling across Workfront and Fusion by reviewing the Fusion Execution Inspector, validating data, conducting QA checks, and resolving configuration or automation issues. •Successfully supported 100+ projects with durations ranging from 3 months to 1 year, assisting project managers with scheduling, task mapping, and resource allocation while ensuring governance compliance. •Created and maintained SOPs, configuration guides, governance documentation, and handover materials, and collaborated with cross-functional teams to support Workfront releases and continuous improvements.
Salesforce Administrator / Analyst (Project-Based), Accenture Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai 02/2021 – 01/2022
Supported Salesforce administration and configuration, including users, roles, profiles, permissions, and access controls for internal and client-facing teams. •Designed and maintained Salesforce reports and dashboards to track service delivery KPIs such as case status, turnaround time, workload, and productivity. •Ensured data accuracy and reliable reporting through validation, clean-up, documentation, and user support.
Accounts Receivable Associate, GEBBS HEALTHCARE SOLUTIONS PVT. LTD. 05/2019 – 03/2020 | Mumbai
Processed insurance claims with accuracy and complied with documentation standards. •Prepared appeal packages and maintained high-quality reporting accuracy.
Operations Consultant (Onboarding & KYC), UBER RIDES/EATS - RANDSTAD/KELLY PVT. LTD. 09/2016 – 04/2019 | Mumbai
Managed partner onboarding workflows, ensuring accurate documentation and verification. •Streamlined verification steps to improve onboarding efficiency and reduce turnaround time.
